key_results: Pr₀.₁Ag₀.₉NbO₃₋δ exhibits direct/indirect band gaps of 3.8/2.2 eV; pseudocapacitive electrochemical behavior; higher antibacterial activity against Gram-negative bacteria; four phase transitions at 317, 436, 528, 742 K.
comments: Comprehensive multifunctional characterization is thorough, but lacks mechanistic insight into simultaneous property optimization or device-level demonstrations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single-phase material exhibits concurrent luminescence, capacitive, and antimicrobial functionality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across all three property classes

title: Resonance-enhanced evanescent optical lattices: comparison of guided-mode, surface-wave, and plasmonic platforms
task: Compare resonant evanescent optical lattices across photonic platforms
key_results: Leaky guided modes provide largest enhancement (highest near-surface intensity); Bloch surface waves and plasmonics offer longer evanescent tails with platform-specific constraints; trade-offs identified between enhancement, accessibility, and penetration depth.
comments: Comprehensive comparison provides useful design guidelines, but practical implementation depends heavily on application requirements (sensing vs. microscopy vs. light-matter interaction).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Platform-specific trade-offs exist between resonant enhancement and field accessibility
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: distinct regimes identified for each platform

title: Electric-circuit reconstruction of urban bus passenger loads on service-frequency-weighted networks
task: Reconstruct urban bus passenger loads from aggregate network data
key_results: Conductance-weighted graph Poisson equation yields R²=0.901 (DOWN) and 0.818 (UP) for full network; R²=0.989–0.963 excluding circular routes; core-station-only reconstruction achieves R²=0.907–0.768 depending on station dominance.
comments: Creative application of circuit analogy to transport networks; practical utility for privacy-preserving passenger flow inference is significant, though applicability depends on network topology.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Conductance-weighted graph model reconstructs passenger flows from boarding-alighting imbalances
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: R²>0.9 for radial networks; effectiveness decreases for non-circular network topologies

title: Pilot reference free continuous variable quantum key distribution with amplitude encoding
task: Develop pilot-reference-free continuous-variable quantum key distribution
key_results: Protocol eliminates pilot-induced crosstalk; operates under fully randomized phase in optical fiber and free-space channels; proof-of-principle experiment demonstrates feasibility.
comments: Simplification of physical implementation and signal processing is valuable, though practical secret key rates and distance performance require more extensive benchmarking.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Amplitude encoding eliminates pilot signal requirement without sacrificing protocol security
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: security analysis under collective attacks shows viability

title: Transducer-free probing of thermal transport in semiconducting molecular and polymer thin films
task: Measure thermal transport in organic semiconductor thin films without metallic transducers
key_results: CuPc exhibits thermal diffusivity several times higher than IDTBT; CuPc shows strong temperature dependence (phonon-phonon/boundary scattering); IDTBT remains temperature-independent (disorder-dominated).
comments: Transducer-free approach enables cryogenic measurements (8–295 K) with superior sensitivity; connection to structural disorder is clear, though applicability limited to materials transparent at probe wavelengths.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Thermal transport mechanisms differ between ordered (CuPc) and disordered (IDTBT) organic semiconductors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: temperature-dependent vs. temperature-independent scaling observed

title: Relative leg-height optimization of micro-thermoelectric coolers for enhanced cooling performance
task: Optimize micro-thermoelectric cooler leg height for enhanced cooling density
key_results: Optimized μTEC achieves ΔT=10.5 K at 293 K and 26.4 K at 373 K; simulations predict hundreds of W/cm² cooling power density; higher packing density and reduced material volume versus conventional designs.
comments: Design innovation enabling denser integration and reduced thermoelectric material usage is practical; simulated performance exceeds demonstrated results, requiring experimental validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Relative leg-height optimization enhances cooling density while maintaining constant cross-section
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: higher packing density and cooling power predicted; experimental demonstration shows ΔT=26.4 K at 373 K
